Subject: dispatch hiring at Brindle

Hi Owen,

Saw Brindle Freight is hiring two dispatch coordinators. Dispatch teams often re-key the same load details into three systems.

Sam

Not relevant? Reply "no" and I won't contact you again.

Not now, I'm afraid. We've had to stop all new projects until the merger closes in March. Try me again in April?

Owen
